aggregation: sum numerators and denominators across one approved product/cycle version; no arithmetic average of shift percentages
business_date: explicit export field; overnight date must not be inferred
revision_policy: Filter source record-time issued_at <= explicit as_of_cutoff BEFORE conflict detection; then select maximum integer revision. Exact same-content replay skipped; conflicting same identity+revision quarantined with no fallback. This reconstructs historical source record revisions, not historical receiver knowledge.
scope: synthetic metric review, no production benchmark or ROI
